decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-06 is down at TJ-C512-01 (OT-5100, hydraulic, 1 to 2 h on site), so no confirmation is needed. TJ-C512-01 has 251 - 107 = 144 t of broken ore left, about 33 oz at 7.2 g/t. Without a loan, LH-06 would be repaired by 12:00 at the latest. Loading is 07:00-11:00 and 11:30-17:00, so the loader would have about 5 h at 35.6 t/h (LH514 at 220 m), roughly 178 t. That is more than the 144 t left, so all of it gets mucked by 17:00 even in the worst repair case. The Central stockpile is at 147 of 450 t, so it is not full. A loan of LH-08 from DS-C538-01 would cost about 0.34 h of travel plus 0.2 oz per hour away, and it would add essentially no ore. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 and its place is not a loading stope or a heading, so it cannot lend. No reserve can be activated because no stope is stopped. Best action: no moves, net gain of 0 oz versus doing nothing.
